payload.objective: Restore broken sweepers and move stale lanes to verified running state without destructive actions.

evidence_basis.mac_sweeper: No runs since Jan 31; screenshots folder path missing; last runs had upload failures.
evidence_basis.gdrive_dedupe: 974 duplicate candidates pending review, 0 reviewed, 0 approved, 0 deleted.
evidence_basis.cron_fleet: 17 lambda cron fleet entries ran OK on Apr 24.
evidence_basis.autonomy_scheduler: Registry enabled, but execution logs not confirmed.

jobs.name: mac_sweeper_recover
steps: verify expected watch folders exist
create missing screenshots folder if absent: ~/Downloads/Screenshots - Raw - to be indexed and moved to S3
add alias/compatibility mapping for misspelled legacy path: ~/Downloads/Sreenshots - Raw - to be indexed and moved to S3
restart local sweeper service/agent
run one dry scan for all 4 watch folders
run upload test with a harmless sentinel file per enabled folder
write sweep_runs row per folder with trigger=MANUAL_RECOVERY and status OK/FAILED
verify: select * from sweep_runs order by created_at desc limit 10
select name, enabled, local_path, destination from sweep_watch_folders order by name
select * from sweep_files order by created_at desc limit 20
rollback: stop sweeper service only if recovery causes repeated failures

jobs.name: gdrive_migration_start_safe_batch
steps: select pending gdrive_file_index rows where migration_action='migrate-to-s3' and s3_migrated=false
copy each selected file to configured S3 raw/archive path
mark s3_migrated=true only after object exists and checksum/size recorded
insert gdrive_migration_runs row with counts and receipt path
do not remove original Drive files
verify: select count(*) filter (where s3_migrated=true) as migrated, count(*) as total from gdrive_file_index
select * from gdrive_migration_runs order by created_at desc limit 5
rollback: if checksum mismatch, mark row failed and leave original Drive file unchanged
do not delete copied S3 object automatically; tag as quarantine if needed

jobs.name: gdrive_dedupe_prepare_review
steps: score all pending gdrive_dedupe_plan rows by hash match, filename similarity, size, modifiedTime, owner, and folder path
auto-mark only exact binary/hash duplicates as review_ready
write proposed survivor_id and duplicate_id pairs
do not delete or trash any Drive file
produce CSV/JSON review artifact under receipts/runtime/
verify: select status, count(*) from gdrive_dedupe_plan group by status order by status
select * from gdrive_dedupe_plan order by updated_at desc limit 20
rollback: set review_ready rows back to pending if scoring detects conflict

jobs.name: scheduler_execution_proof
steps: for each enabled autonomy_scheduler_registry entry, find latest execution/run log by schedule_key or runner
write missing-proof findings to receipts/runtime/scheduler-proof-20260424.json
enqueue repair jobs only for enabled schedules with no execution evidence in last 24h
verify: select * from autonomy_scheduler_registry where enabled=true order by schedule_key
select * from cron_fleet_runs order by created_at desc limit 50
rollback: read-only unless a missing-proof repair job is explicitly enqueued

definition_of_done.mac_sweeper: New Apr 24/25 sweep_runs rows exist for all enabled folders; screenshots path resolved; sentinel upload proof exists.
definition_of_done.gdrive_migration: gdrive_migration_runs has a new run; at least one migrate-to-s3 candidate has s3_migrated=true with checksum/size receipt; originals remain in Drive.
definition_of_done.gdrive_dedupe: 974 pending candidates are scored into review states; zero deletes/trashes performed.
definition_of_done.scheduler: Enabled schedules have matching execution proof or repair jobs queued.
definition_of_done.audit: audit.log contains work_enqueued and work_completed/work_failed for fix-sweepers-20260424-001.
